nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=60 beats='Holiday Monday morning at last: the playground lies empty and sunny, the yellow hen notebook rides in the bike basket, and Miri has the three school hens all to herself for the whole week'>>

choices.label: Count the hens from the gate
Hurry straight into the run

Check the little gate to the lane

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Inside the run only Hazel and Pepper bustle up to the fence; tiny Pip is nowhere; one white feather twirls down through the sunbeams, tiny prints speckle the dust bath, and the treat tin waits heavy in her pocket'>>

Slip out the little gate to the lane

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='Two more white feathers tremble on the fence wire; three-toed prints dot the mud by the kale bed and head out over the dewy field, and the treat tin in one pocket gives a hopeful little rattle'>>

choices.label: Follow the tiny muddy prints
Shake the treat tin loudly

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='The prints cross the empty running track into the long grass toward the orchard; off to the left the old gardening shed stands with its door ajar, and high above the whole field a skylark sings'>>

choices.label: Tiptoe on into the orchard
Look inside the old shed first

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='A big shake of the tin brings Hazel and Pepper thundering over but no Pip; the rattle echoes oddly off the old shed wall, while one last white feather points the way toward the orchard trees'>>

choices.label: March rattling toward the orchard
Tiptoe rattling toward the shed

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Under the apple trees the windfalls wear small neat pecks; one thin thread of a peep floats from the bramble thicket, and a rusty wheelbarrow heaped with dry leaves wears one white tail feather on its handle'>>

choices.label: Part the brambles toward the peep
Peek into the leaf-filled wheelbarrow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Deep in the green canes sits Pip, small and blazing with hen outrage, one leg wrapped twice in a prickly runner; Miri slips off her cardigan and lays it open on the grass like a little bed'>>

choices.label: Unwrap the prickly runner loop by loop
Rattle the tin till she hops free

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='Curled in the warm leaves like a teapot cosy, fast asleep with one wing over her face, sits Pip; under that wing three speckled eggs glow, and the school egg box waits empty on the shed shelf'>>

choices.label: Carry hen and eggs home snug
Fetch Mr Finch and the hay basket

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='The shed smells of dust and old raincoats; flowerpots rattle softly in the gloom, a blue bucket in the middle of the floor wobbles once entirely by itself, and a broken board gapes onto the wild strip out back'>>

choices.label: Creak in toward the blue bucket
Squeeze through the broken board

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Torch beam, cobwebs, one small white feather; the blue bucket wobbles again on the dusty floor, and from behind the stack of flowerpot crates comes a tiny scratchy hustle, like somebody rebuilding a nest in a hurry'>>

Peek behind the flowerpot crates

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Behind the crates: four amazed mice, one old scarf, and a drift of white feathers; a last feather floats out through the broken board, and the scratch marks lead round in hopeful little circles'>>

choices.label: Follow the feather out the back
Go lift that blue bucket after all

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=62 beats='Nettles, one old football, one white feather and no hen; the marks circle twice and simply stop; over the hedge the lane smells of cut grass, and up at the run the evening light is gathering'>>

choices.label: Trudge back up to the coop
Rattle the tin at the hedge gap

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Miri lifts the bucket very slowly; FWOOF; out rockets Pip in a burst of dust and feathers with a grey cobweb perched on her comb like a little hat, and the shed door stands wide to the sunny field'>>

choices.label: Catch the dusty little rocket
Race her back up to the run

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=58 beats='The little gate swings into an empty lane smelling of cut grass; opposite stands a cottage with a blue door under yellow roses, its garden gate wide, and the ditch runs green and jungly'>>

choices.label: Cross the lane to the blue door
Search the jungly green ditch

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='In the long grass of the ditch one downy white feather clings to a dock leaf; something rustles upstream toward the cottage garden, and downstream the ditch bends round toward the wild strip behind the school'>>

choices.label: Nose along toward the cottage garden
Follow the ditch round to the wild strip

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=64 beats='Tiny dusty prints cross the path and vanish among the strawberry rows; a kitchen window stands open; from somewhere in the garden comes one small, satisfied, strawberry-flavoured burp'>>

choices.label: Tiptoe between the strawberry rows
Knock on the little blue door

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=64 beats='Half the best berries wear neat beak marks and red smears dot the leaves; the reddest, leafiest corner jerks once, goes still, then jerks again; the gate stands open behind and the tin is heavy in one pocket'>>

choices.label: Peek at the rustling red corner
Rattle the tin from the gate

choices.label: Scoop up the sticky little bandit
Rattle the tin and stroll for home

choices.label: Own up and promise a punnet
Come in for stripey-glass lemonade

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=64 beats='The little blue door opens almost at once; Mrs Plum stands there holding a tea towel, and beside the warm stove in a cardboard box sits a small round white hen eating toast crusts like a queen at breakfast'>>

choices.label: Carry the queen straight home
Stay for stripey-glass lemonade

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='In the warm kitchen Mrs Plum pours lemonade into stripey glasses and declares the little hen the politest burglar she has ever met; Pip hiccups toast-crumb hiccups from her cardboard throne, faintly pink about the beak'>>

choices.label: Cycle home with cake in the basket
Walk the sleepy queen home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=64 beats='One good rattle of the tin and out of the green pops a small white shape; Pip falls in behind in a wobbly line, pausing for one butterfly, one puddle, and one long thoughtful look at the sky'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=60 beats='Pip rides home in a cardigan sling through the low gold light; by the coop waits Mr Finch with the red toolbox, and together they size up the wiggly old latch while Hazel and Pepper mutter at the fence'>>

choices.label: Fix the wiggly latch before bedtime
Do the evening count together

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Back at the run the light goes honey-gold; Hazel and Pepper pace the fence; the coop door still leans on its tired old latch; the yellow notebook has one empty line left and the evening count cannot wait'>>

Call Mr Finch about the latch
